title: A frobenius linear endomorphism of a finite dimensional vector space over an algebraically closed field has surjective F minus one
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a frobenius linear endomorphism F of a finite dimensional vector space over an algebraically closed field of characteristic p has F - 1 surjective, with kernel of dimension at most dim_k(V) over F_p (statement lines 9640-9648). The proof combines three arguments: a reduction to the case of injective F via F-stable filtrations and the case F = 0 (proof lines 9651-9654), the inversion of the matrix of F to turn surjectivity into the system of p-power equations lambda_j^p minus sum b_{ij}lambda_i = sum b_{ij}mu_i (proof lines 9657-9675), and the construction of the algebra A defined by those equations, which is standard smooth because the partial derivatives of the x_j^p vanish and whose monomial basis shows dim_k(A) = p^n (proof lines 9676-9685). Surjectivity then follows by counting the p^n points of Spec(A) through algebraic closedness of k (proof lines 9686-9688). The claim is H2: three explicit steps, each short, with the algebra construction as the non-formal core.
